create-instance.import-hint: Pick a modpack file (.mrpack / .zip). The game version and loader come from its manifest; the import runs in the background — watch it in Downloads.
create-instance.import-partial: Imported, but {p1} file(s) could not be downloaded — check the instance content page
instance-settings.export-desc: Pack this instance into a .mrpack to share. Registered mods / resource packs / shaders are stored as download links only, so the archive stays small.
instance-settings.export-done: Created {p1} and opened the share sheet
plugins.external-opened: This plugin isn't hosted on Hangar — opened the download page in your browser; drop the jar into the server's plugins folder afterwards
plugins.no-download: This plugin has no downloadable file (the API returned no download URL)
install-dialog.no-server-yet: No server yet — create one under More → Multiplayer
install-dialog.plugin-hint: Plugins go into the server's plugins folder; a build matching that server's MC version is picked automatically
install-dialog.plugin-compat-unknown: This plugin does not declare supported MC versions — it may not work
server-detail.plugins-hint: Search PaperMC's plugin platform (Hangar). A build matching this server's MC version is picked automatically and dropped into the plugins folder.
server-detail.plugins-compat-unknown: This plugin does not declare supported MC versions — it may not work
server-detail.plugins-delete-confirm: Delete {p1}? The server will stop loading it on next start.
